items.headline: Upbit Lists $HYPE With Direct KRW Pairs
items.summary: Upbit will open direct Korean-won pairs for $HYPE, adding a major fiat on-ramp after $HYPE briefly outpaced BTC around the announcement.

items.headline: $IRIS Brings Fixed-Rate Borrowing to SparkLend
items.summary: $IRIS is wiring fixed-rate borrowing into SparkLend liquidity, a new DeFi credit primitive launching as rate demand returns.

items.headline: $ZEST Loans Jump 132% to $14.75M in Q3
items.summary: Zest Protocol’s $ZEST credit market saw Q3 loan volume surge 132% to $14.75M, a small-but-growing Bitcoin DeFi signal worth watching.

items.headline: Threshold $T Bridge Resumes Onchain, App Paused
items.summary: Threshold says $tBTC bridging is back onchain while the app remains paused, keeping $T in focus after the week-long disruption.

items.headline: Staked $INJ ETF Hits $16.12M in Two Sessions
items.summary: Canary’s staked $INJ ETF reached $16.12M across its first two Nasdaq sessions, signaling steady TradFi demand for staked altcoin exposure.
